crm.consent.ack_grant: The guest gave this consent themselves after seeing the consent notice above.
crm.consent.ack_withdraw: The guest asked to withdraw this consent (or I am correcting a wrong record).
crm.consent.confirm_desc: Consent changes are legal records. They are saved with your name, the time, the source and the notice version.
crm.consent.legal_1: Marketing consent is given per channel and is separate from transactional messages. Booking confirmations, payment links and stay information are sent to perform the contract and need no marketing consent.
crm.consent.legal_2: Under KVKK (Law No. 6698), the GDPR and, in Türkiye, the e-commerce law (No. 6563), consent must be freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous. Record how it was given and which version of the consent notice the guest saw.
crm.consent.legal_3: Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it and takes effect immediately. Every change is kept in the history below, and marketing exports include only guests who consented to that channel.
crm.consent.legal_title: KVKK / GDPR: how marketing consent works
crm.consent.none_hint: No marketing consent on any channel
crm.consent.source_hint: How did the guest express this choice?
crm.consent.subtitle: Marketing permission per channel
crm.consent.text_version_hint_grant: The version of the consent / privacy notice the guest agreed to.
crm.consent.title: Consent
crm.consent.transactional_note: Transactional messages (confirmations, payment links, stay information) do not depend on this consent.
